faq.q: What case studies does Designit have?
faq.a: Five client engagements broken into 18 case studies: Adda247 (EdTech), Kelp Global (fintech, private markets), Betacrew (developer tools), R-Centric for the Omniyat portfolio (luxury real estate) and Tata Elxsi (automotive HMI).

A redesign across Adda247's competitive-exam preparation platform, including the homepage, test series, live classes, performance dashboard, community, a native iOS and iPad app, and more. See the Adda247 case study.

faq.q: What was designed for Kelp Global?
faq.a: Three connected products for private-markets investment teams, on one design system: a deals module with company one-pagers, IC notes, valuations and comparison; a plugin that files emails to deals from the inbox; and the Truenorth investor portal. See the Kelp Global case study.

faq.q: Can we see work that isn't published here?
faq.a: Some work is under NDA. On a call we can walk you through relevant projects that aren't public.

faq.q: How is each Designit case study structured?
faq.a: The same way every time: the problem statement, who we designed for and their pain points, the challenges, our approach, the experience we created with screens, a gallery and a FAQ. Each page also lists the client, industry, deliverables and platform up front.

faq.q: Which industries does Designit have case studies in?
faq.a: EdTech (Adda247), fintech and private markets (Kelp Global), developer tools (Betacrew), luxury real estate in Dubai (R-Centric for Omniyat) and automotive HMI (Tata Elxsi).

faq.q: Do the case studies include web, mobile and other platforms?
faq.a: Yes: web apps and dashboards, Android, iOS and iPad apps, a smart-board app, an inbox plugin, an investor portal, luxury property websites, and in-car displays.

faq.q: How do I choose the right case study to read?
faq.a: Use the filters by industry or service, or start from the problem closest to yours: a confusing product (test series, My Content), low engagement (homepage revamp, community), dense data (Kelp deals, Truenorth) or a premium website (the Omniyat properties).

faq.q: Can I talk to Designit about a project similar to one of these?
faq.a: Yes. Start a project or book a call and mention the case study; we'll tell you where we would start and whether we're the right partner.
